data_fields.name: batch overscan rows
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 row beyond the viewport (BATCH_SIZE = cols x (rows + 1))

best_idea: Render a long bag or bank grid one viewport plus one row at a time from a pool of tiles, load the next batch when the scroll is three rows from the bottom, and rebuild from the first batch whenever a filter or sort changes.
decision_why: Take the batch, pool and scroll threshold for the phone bag and bank; the donor computes the batch once (fix: recompute on resize), hard-codes the cell size (fix: read it from the layout), and clamps only on the client (the server must refuse an over-withdraw).
acceptance: On a 375 px wide phone the bag shows its first screen of entries at once, scrolling loads the next batch three rows before the bottom, rotating the phone recomputes the batch size, and a server test refuses a withdraw above the stored amount.
